title: Pages — the shell, round 9: the Pages button opens the view

steps.headline: The Pages button opens the page view itself: panel on the left, an empty frame saying No page selected.
steps.changed: From your note during the first try: no library first. The view opens with the panel pinned open and the frame waiting for a pick; the panel toggle is gone.
steps.notice: One click from anywhere lands you among your pages, with the frame ready.
steps.risk: There is no way to hide the panel any more; on a phone it will need its own answer later.

steps.path: The band across the top of the page view
steps.headline: The band's left cluster is the app's own three icons: Settings, Pages (lit), Projects.
steps.changed: The panel toggle is replaced by the same Settings, Pages and Projects buttons the chat band has, wired to the same places. No chat/terminal toggle, no files, no games.
steps.notice: Settings and Projects are reachable without leaving pages; Pages is lit because you are in it.

steps.headline: A filled Create a page button with a plus sits above Manage pages.
steps.changed: Create a page is the one filled button in the view; Manage pages stays as the outlined pill below it. Both fill the panel's width.
steps.notice: Making a page is the first thing the panel offers; managing is second.

steps.headline: The old Pages screen is now Manage pages, reached only from the panel, and Back returns to the view.
steps.changed: Titled Manage pages. Its back affordance reads Esc · Back and closes onto the page view it came from, not to chat.
steps.notice: Cards, pencil and pin work as before; opening a card lands you in the view with that page.

steps.path: Page view → the Projects icon in the band
steps.headline: Projects replaces the page view in place, and its header gains the Pages button, so the two toggle from the header.
steps.changed: From your second note: the Projects icon in the page view's band swaps in Project View; Project View's header now carries the Pages button beside its title; a second press of Pages anywhere returns to chat; the gear in the band opens Settings over the view.
steps.notice: Settings, Pages and Projects behave the same in the page view as in chat, and Pages and Projects flip back and forth.
steps.risk: Project View is a protected screen; the only change to it is the one button beside its title.
